{{Top|leg}}
'''Oberle''' was a company that produced [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The company made speeder bikes for both factions and its models included the [[Banshee (speeder)|Banshee]] and the [[Siren (speeder)|Siren]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
